title: Upcoming sessions at one Institution
description: Open days, information sessions, webinars and campus tours an Institution runs for prospective students. One file per Institution: data/sessions/<institution id>.json. Rendered in the 'Deadlines & sessions' panel on the Institution's page and on its Programme pages; a session in the past is not shown, and a file with no sessions renders nothing.

institution.description: The Institution these sessions belong to. Must match the file name.

notes.description: Anything a researcher should know about this Institution's sessions in general, e.g. 'runs a webinar every month; dates are published six weeks ahead'. Not rendered.

endDate.description: For a session that runs over several days.

title.description: The session's own name, e.g. 'Bachelor's Open Day'.

kind.description: What sort of session it is. 'fair' is a fair the Institution attends, not one it runs.

dates.description: Every date it runs. A webinar repeated monthly is one session with several dates.

place.description: Where, for an in-person or hybrid session: campus and city. Required unless the session is online.

url.description: Where a student signs up or reads more.

registration.description: Whether a student must sign up beforehand.

language.description: The language it is held in, if not English.

audience.description: Who it is for. 'any' when it is open to every prospective student.

audienceNote.description: A narrower audience in words, e.g. 'international applicants only'.

programmes.description: Programme ids, when the session is about particular programmes. Empty or absent: about the Institution as a whole.

note.description: One line a student needs, e.g. 'recordings are posted afterwards'.

source.description: The page the date was read from.

checkedAt.description: When the source was last read.
